edges.note: Splice measure: head lead and picture lead limit, tail window, sound above floor, floor percentile and digital silence boundary.

shots.note: Publish and shorts shortest picture in frames; take-ends expression minimum and held-face maximum. Shared by J-cut remaining picture and short pieces.

jcuts.note: J-cut lead frame minimum, maximum seconds, body motion percentage and frames after onset; source-word extension tolerance.

takes.note: Splice stumble detector window and longest repeated run; repeat detector phrase length and story window. Transcript owns filler classification.

shorts.note: Shorts pause split, interior pad, outer head and tail pads, and duration band from the shorts checker. Standalone-opening pronouns and backward-reference categories.

patches.note: Voice-patch quiet join search starts ten milliseconds clear of the word edge.
